Carrot plant, mature and ready to harvest.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | World block; cannot be placed directly as an inventory item |

## How to obtain

Find wild plants on grassy terrain or grow them from planting stock. See [Farming and cooking](Farming-and-cooking.md).

## Using it

Young plants return one planting item only. Mature plants yield resources and two seeds. Prepare farmland with a hoe to plant; no watering is required.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
